overview: Cross-reference to Vincent's 1935 Kwantung report, plus a 1936 Dairen despatch on the Kwantung Government's thirtieth anniversary at Port Arthur, attended by Japanese/Manchukuo officials, assessing limited Chinese education and strengthened Japan-Manchukuo ties.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Atcheson despatch transmitting Vincent’s Kwantung report
subfiles.about: The sheet directs researchers to another file for George Atcheson Jr.’s despatch transmitting John Carter Vincent’s report on the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Atcheson's 1935 despatch transmitting Vincent's Kwantung Leased Territory report, filed under 894C.01/84.

subfiles.title: Despatch on the thirtieth anniversary of the Kwantung Government
subfiles.from: Stuart L. Grummon, American Consul at Dairen
subfiles.to: Erle R. Dickover, American Chargé d’Affaires ad interim, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Grummon reports on the Port Arthur commemoration of thirty years of Japanese government in the Kwantung Leased Territory and discusses colonial education for the Chinese population.
subfiles.summary: Grummon reports the 1936 thirtieth-anniversary ceremony at Port Arthur, attended by senior Japanese/Manchukuo officials; he flags Chinese education as a failure (only 30 percent schooled per Takebe) despite new 1937 budget spending to expand facilities and ties.

interest: Shows Dairen's 1936 colonial-anniversary ceremony and limited Chinese education under Japanese Kwantung administration.
